elements.requirement: The Act may be cited as the Party Wall etc. Act 1996.
elements.quote: This Act may be cited as the Party Wall etc. Act 1996

elements.requirement: The Party Wall etc. Act 1996 shall come into force in accordance with provision made by the Secretary of State by order made by statutory instrument.
elements.quote: This Act shall come into force in accordance with provision made by the Secretary of State by order made by statutory instrument

elements.requirement: An order bringing the Act into force may contain such savings or transitional provisions as the Secretary of State thinks fit.
elements.quote: contain such savings or transitional provisions as the Secretary of State thinks fit

elements.requirement: An order bringing the Act into force may make different provision for different purposes.
elements.quote: make different provision for different purposes

elements.requirement: The Party Wall etc. Act 1996 extends to England and Wales only.
elements.quote: This Act extends to England and Wales only
